title: Casdoor action (action.json)
description: An action is a WebAssembly module built from the Go main package next to action.json with the SDK in sdk/. The build compiles it, writes the module next to bundle.json and adds its sha256 here; Casdoor checks it on install. The module can only send https requests to the hosts in the manifest's permissions.hosts.

kind.description: payment: Casdoor adds a payment provider of type Plugin that calls the module to create and check payments. sms: Casdoor adds an SMS provider of type Plugin that calls the module to send verification codes. push: Casdoor adds a notification provider of type Plugin that sends the sign-in confirmations of the push MFA. syncer: a syncer of type Plugin imports users through the module. password-check: the organization's security settings run the module on every password being set or used to sign in. password-migration: the organization's security settings run the module on the first sign-in of a user imported without a password.

receiverField.description: push only: the user field that holds the receiver, filled in when the user sets up the push MFA.

abi.description: Calling convention between Casdoor and the module, sdk.Abi.

module.description: File name of the compiled module.
